import re

def cut(s, spans):
    out = []
    for k, st in enumerate(spans):
        if k + 1 < len(spans):
            out.append(s[st:spans[k + 1]].strip())
        else:
            out.append(s[st:].strip())
    return out

def parse(lines):
    blocks = []
    skip = []
    used_all = set()
    rule = re.compile(r'^=+(?: +=+)+\s*$')
    prompt = re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z]:\\[^>]*>')
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        ln = lines[i]
        if rule.match(ln) and i > 0:
            spans = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'=+', ln)]
            h = i - 1
            while h >= 0 and not lines[h].strip():
                h -= 1
            names = cut(lines[h], spans) if h >= 0 else ['col%d' % k for k in range(len(spans))]
            used = [i]
            if h >= 0:
                used.insert(0, h)
            recs = []
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and lines[j].strip() and not prompt.match(lines[j]) and not rule.match(lines[j]):
                vals = cut(lines[j], spans)
                recs.append(dict(zip(names, vals)))
                used.append(j)
                j += 1
            used_all.update(used)
            blocks.append({'name': 'drivers', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': recs})
            i = j
            continue
        if ln.strip():
            skip.append(i)
        i += 1
    skip = [k for k in skip if k not in used_all]
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
